name: damage_target
description: Lowers a token's HP by 'damage': its card's hp, or a card-less token's Bar 1.

Data.Label: Where its HP is
Data.Script:
var t = vars.target;
return t.cardId ? { hpOf: t.cardId, hpName: "hp" } : { hpOf: t.id, hpName: "bar1_value" };

Data.Label: New HP
Report to the GM only (names and HP may be secret)
Data.Title: Damage
